McpServerFailure.description: An MCP server whose tools are unavailable to the sessions using it.

runtime_id.description: The runtime hosting the server; `global` for top-level `[mcp]`.

session_ids.description: The affected sessions among those this connection subscribes to.

workspace.description: The hosting instance's workspace, when its runtime has one.

description: MCP server configuration or status changed; refetch `mcp.server.list`.

failures.description:
Servers that failed to connect, or dropped and did not reconnect, in
runtimes that sessions this connection subscribes to are attached
to. Absent when the change carries no failure.
